messages:
Sam Chen: secops alert — unusual KMS GenerateDataKey activity: 12 calls in 3m from service account svc-ingest-prod. Seen source IPs 34.120.45.12 and 35.200.78.99. Looks like automated bursts. Possible key exposure.

Sam Chen: ```json
{"event":"GenerateDataKey","key_id":"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/rdw-prod-enc","principal":"svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","src_ip":"34.120.45.12","time":"2026-03-20T14:02:12Z"}
```

Anya Patel: ack. I'm creating the war room and taking incident commander. @Mike please take containment (disable SA + revoke tokens). @Taylor pls collect network and bucket access logs.

Mike Lopez: on it. Disabled service account: `gcloud iam service-accounts disable svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod` and revoked recent OIDC tokens. Confirmed no new calls from that principal.

Taylor Rivera: Pulling VPC flow logs, storage access, and app auth logs now. Starting targeted filter for `svc-ingest-prod` and the two IPs.

Priya Nair: Mirroring audit logs to secure bucket `gs://secops-retention/inc-1805550123/` and enabling enhanced KMS admin logging to SIEM.

incident-bot: Alert -> ticket INC-2026-1845 created (Priority: P1) by Anya Patel.

Mike Lopez: Starting key rotation: created new key version `rdw-prod-enc:v4`. Deploy plan: update staging infra to use v4, validate, then promote to prod. ETA ~6m for canary validation.

Sam Chen: any signs of exfil or unauthorized data access? Taylor?

Taylor Rivera: No large egress spikes in VPC logs. Found a couple of small POSTs to external endpoint `api-collector.example.com` around the same time — low payload sizes. Correlating with app logs to see if data contained file refs.

Anya Patel: Containment checklist so far: 1) Disable SA (Mike) 2) Rotate KMS key (Mike) 3) Revoke sessions & CI secrets referencing SA (Mike/Taylor) 4) Lock down related buckets with temporary deny policy (Priya) 5) Notify support and legal if data impacted (Priya).

Mike Lopez: Rotation complete for staging. Initiating prod rollout now; will run a quick smoke to confirm encryption/decryption flows. Pushing canary to 20% traffic.

Priya Nair: Support notified and on watch. Drafted short customer-facing statement in #support-drafts in case we need it.

Sam Chen: Good. I'm assigning post-incident actions: Anya will lead RCA and timeline, Taylor continue log collection and correlation, Mike to write key rotation and secret remediation runbook. I'll start timeline notes and handoff doc.

Anya Patel: Copy. I'll create the follow-up doc and link all logs/timestamps. Next shift handoff scheduled at 03:30 UTC — night oncall please continue audit review and confirm no further GenerateDataKey spikes.

Mike Lopez: Leaving remediation checklist in the ticket: rotate any dependent keys, inspect CI/CD variables for leaked SA tokens, rotate downstream service credentials, run automated credential scanning across repos.

Sam Chen: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: Closing the active war room; keep updating this thread with any new findings.

deploy-bot: Prod canary deploy (rdw-runtime) successful — 20% -> 100% complete.

Sam Chen: Noted. All clear for now.
note: This thread contains the root alert, commands used for containment, short logs, assignments, and handoff notes.
